source_control_definition.setup: Separate issuer login plus two runtime/worker READ COMMITTED connections; issue nonnullable immutable tuple before each bind
source_control_definition.action: Exercise full ROLLBACK after bind; SAVEPOINT then bind then ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT then full rollback; a failed bind; commit then same-pool reuse; different backend, same backend/new xid, and wrong isolation. Try every old token in a later transaction, then obtain a freshly authorized tuple grant for the same semantic command key
source_control_definition.expected: Old tuple survives bind rollback in issuer-owned committed row and never authorizes a later xid; no runtime/helper grant writes; fresh grant succeeds. Same-live-transaction rebind is idempotent

source_customer.name: ctx01-source-customer

SQL contains neither handle nor issuer writes. Failure requires client/backend closure before independent observer; never treat command count as a commit proof.
source_customer.diagnostic_limit: For P0002 require source-bound customer_atomic frame; state alone does not identify missing history/evidence. Unlisted diagnostics stop. 23505 proves native duplicate rejection only, not a production semantic-idempotency adapter.

source_creation_lifetime_protocol.limit: Same SQL source group retried once after proven rollback; not an owner application adapter or durable committed-result replay.

worker_read_scope_limit: Actual worker SELECT uses existing runtime.claim_work/work.claim transport scope and exact pending fence0 job. No claim, lease, enrollment, owner result, pure-query purpose or worker loop is created.

runtime_binding_contract.login: Actual separately authenticated login, never SET ROLE.
runtime_binding_contract.isolation: READ COMMITTED except explicit denial controls.
runtime_binding_contract.tuple_capture: Capture actual session_user/current_user/database/PID/full xid/backend_start before protected work; exact PID and full xid must come from that same connection.
runtime_binding_contract.issuance: Fresh UUID grant instance and 256-bit secret per issue step; independently committed immutable row through actual wa_context_issuer; hash only in database, issuer client/backend closed before bind. Bound instance labels refer to memory only.
runtime_binding_contract.lifetime: SAVEPOINT is after tuple capture but before first bind, with fresh connection/no preexisting hash. ROLLBACK TO clears binding; same live full xid may rebind. Full ROLLBACK/COMMIT require explicit acknowledgements before BEGIN/new xid capture.
runtime_binding_contract.error: ON_ERROR_STOP remains enabled. Each expected binder failure requires exact psql3, no ACK, exactly one allowlisted source-bound diagnostic/frame. End connection; never send a later behavioral statement on it.
runtime_binding_contract.closure: Client exit plus independent absence of exact PID/backend_start/login/database before full-state observers. Same-backend new-xid controls finish before this closure; no concurrent business observer is used between their transactions.
runtime_binding_contract.grant_retention: External coordinator must derive fixed query from runtime-only instance UUIDs and compare issuer-owned immutable fields/token hashes to their pre-issue expectations; emit only exact_count/all_immutable_fields_equal/issuer_owned/revoked_false/unexpired booleans. Never retain hashes, secrets, PIDs, xids, backend_start or raw rows.
runtime_binding_contract.every_old_instance: After each finite case and source-creation lifetime protocol, test EVERY issued instance in a fresh actual declared-login READ COMMITTED connection with distinct xid while unrevoked/unexpired; require exact stale binder42501/psql3/noACK and closure. Runtime instance maps remain memory-only. Wrong-isolation cases also retain valid committed grant and retry only at new tuple; no expiry/revocation substitution for tuple proof.
runtime_binding_contract.output: Only allowlisted counts/Boolean comparisons/stage/exit code/source hashes. No arbitrary stderr, diagnostic dictionary, statement bodies or credentials. Persist incrementally on every stage and unexpected failure; stop later cases.

unprepared_obligations.limit: Customer resolve covered only. No invented Customer SH003, projection/history/access-evidence write purpose or append-read proof.
Synthetic independent service bootstrap supports worker binding only; generation/revoke transitions remain worker CTX02 proposal scope.
No age/consent mutation or empty-context registry is fabricated here.

safety_review_requirements: Review session FSM and every dynamic instance allocation/tuple equality; source packet is NOT a runtime coordinator.
Pin all source/helper/output hashes before helper execution or SQL; bind fresh immutable created container ID externally.
Authentication, original-grantor finalization and complete native catalog must pass before setup; rerun exact trigger restoration after any failure closure.
Verify every issued grant row remains immutable/issuer-owned across consumer rollback and binder failure without exporting handle or tuple.
Stop on unexpected diagnostic, marker, count, rollback/COMMIT acknowledgment, identity, closure or fixture conflict; retain partial sanitized evidence and controlled exact-resource cleanup.
All94 selection and451 database register cases remain NOT_RUN outside individually reviewed/exercised assertions; no migration/hosted/product/P0D authority.
